inputs.prompt:
Image 1 is the exact spatial storyboard and composition for one 9:16 mobile game scene. Image 2 is style reference only. Do not copy Image 2's composition. Paint the complete Image 1 as one coherent northern winter city logistics illustration: connected roads and intersections, urban houses, snow banks, warm windows, and one broad complete blue warehouse with a snow roof, three loading gates, a loading yard, barrier, and connected roads. Keep the elevated three-quarter camera, all landmark positions, vertical distribution, and relative scale from Image 1. The warehouse is the dominant landmark and is much wider than every vehicle.

Render exactly four visible vehicles, all in the same scene and illustration pass, with no background traffic, no duplicates, and no cropped fragments. The four must be simultaneously countable at mobile size: (1) a small old muted blue-grey tarp truck on the distant upper-left service road by the inspection post; (2) a compact light-grey panel van directly outside the warehouse's right-hand loading exit, visibly in the yard beside the orange barrier and tight snow turn; (3) a blue crew box truck on the lower-left middle road with exactly two separate adult drivers side by side in the windshield; (4) a modern bright-orange Express box truck on the lower-right open arterial with one Express wordmark on its cargo body. Do not leave the right-hand loading exit empty. Do not turn the near van into a building, sign, shadow, or road marking.

Use visual cause-and-effect to tell the choice story without labels: old is far but operational with faded paint, thin exhaust and thin tracks; near is closest to the warehouse, with front wheels visibly turned, a barrier and snow bank pinching its exit, and only short compressed ruts; crew is traveling steadily with two readable drivers and continuous tracks; Express is already moving fastest on open road with subtle radial wheel motion, rear-tire spray, and the longest low tapered powder-snow trail. Use restrained painterly tire compression, wheel blur, tracks, powder, snow buildup, and contact shadows. No comic speed lines, glow, arrows, smoke cloud, decorative streaks, or extra text.

Keep every vehicle small: old about 8% of image width, near about 10%, crew about 16%, Express about 14%, and never any vehicle above 18%. Calm city and warehouse support the story. No UI, labels, pins, circles, route overlays, advertisements, numbers, logos, photorealism, glossy 3D, low-poly toy style, flat aerial plan, pasted cutouts, or changed camera. The only readable word in the artwork is Express on the orange truck.
